title: A small ritual: bread on the counter
excerpt: On patience, imperfect loaves, and finding a little magic in the everyday.
body:
A loaf cooling on the counter makes the whole house feel different. Today’s loaf had a slightly lopsided shape and a beautiful, crackly crust.

I’m keeping notes on proofing time as the kitchen gets cooler. A slower rise seems to give the dough more flavor. The lesson for today: give things the time they need.
